Class PdfDocumentWriter

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.report.pdf.PdfDocumentWriter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class PdfDocumentWriter extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Flowing A4 document with protected page furniture, outlines and a second pass for contents and page counts.
